headline: Deadlands and Lykos Show Fresh Base Activity
war_summary: The latest ledger finds the liveliest movement in Deadlands and Lykos Isle. Deadlands remains split seven Colonial bases to four Warden, but logged three ownership events in the past two hours and 11 across the day; casualty rates and enlistments are accelerating on both comparisons. Lykos Isle now stands four Warden to three Colonial, with two fresh events and 11 over 24 hours, while both casualty ledgers have cooled against the preceding two-hour window. Fisherman’s Row, the previous edition’s chief scene of base swings, is quiet in the latest two hours, though its daily tally remains highest at 28 and the map stays divided seven Warden to two Colonial. Linn Mercy has likewise recorded no new event in the latest two hours, but its 15 daily changes keep the front worth watching. Clahstra and Weathered Expanse report the heaviest sustained fighting, with accelerating losses in Clahstra and more than 1,000 casualties per side over the latest two hours in Weathered, yet neither shows a recorded base event. Elsewhere, most sectors remain settled or comparatively quiet.
